children: said Friday it agreed to sell ​a 5% stake in the Browse gas ‌project offshore Western Australia to Japan's Osaka Gas
, reducing its working interest to 34.33%; financial terms were not disclosed.
Browse is ​Australia's largest undeveloped ​gas ⁠resource and is earmarked as backfill to the North West Shelf ​LNG facility in Western Australia; Woodside Energy is the operator.
The project continues to progress towards front-end engineering and design and the securing of the necessary environmental approvals.
It ​is ⁠expected to produce 11M metric tons/year of liquefied natural gas, and Osaka Gas
said it expects ⁠to ​secure ~550K tons/year of LNG through its stake.

title: BP to sell stake in Australia's Browse gas project to Osaka Gas
